knownRisks.upstream: GTK3 glib-macros 0.18.5 and gtk3-macros 0.18.2 via Tauri/WebKitGTK on Linux
knownRisks.resolution: Adopt compatible maintained GTK3 macro dependencies when upstream provides them; do not force GTK4 or fork the framework merely to clear an informational warning.

knownRisks.upstream: zbus 5 via tauri-plugin-opener 2.5.5 and tauri-plugin-single-instance 2.x on Linux
knownRisks.resolution: Upgrade the plugins when stable upstream supports zbus 6; its names module replaces this crate. A forced major replacement is not API compatible.

knownRisks.upstream: zbus 5 and zbus_macros 5 via the Linux opener/single-instance plugins
knownRisks.resolution: Follow the plugins' compatible migration to zbus 6 and its wire module; verify D-Bus activation and single-instance behavior on native Linux.
Remove with the upstream zbus 6 migration, not by mixing incompatible derive/runtime types.
Track a compatible GTK3 fix for VariantStrIter; the fixed glib >=0.20 line cannot simply replace 0.18.5. Application reachability remains unproven and native Linux validation remains required.
